text: ERK1/2 is upregulated by both aerobic endurance and resistance training, and the magnitude of its phosphorylation correlates with the intensity of exercise (141). Studies investigating the role of ERK1/2 in the regulation of muscle mass have been somewhat conflicting. On one hand, there is evidence that it mediates satellite proliferation and induces muscle protein synthesis
